title: Amazon Cashback: 20% on Amazon Devices, 10% Tools + Home Improvement, 5% Kitchen + Home + Furniture
body:
Deal: Amazon Cashback: 20% on Amazon Devices, 10% Tools + Home Improvement, 5% Kitchen + Home + Furniture

[bin555] These Amazon cashback are not really there. I've only seen them when you buy Amazon products. Rest just seen like marketing. Just spent $226 on Amazon on home and kitchen items. Cashback was $0.91.
[DrFish] That's interesting. I ordered a Kindle, and it worked fine (but that's an Amazon product…). Which product group does the stuff you bought fall under if you chunk the link into https://au.camelcamelcamel.com/ ? Do they all show up at home and or kitchen?
[kyoumei] I mean, you got exactly what was offered, the 0.04%? You'd get a better cashback if you buy items in the relevant categories. Good for people that are after a kindle or fire stick. Otherwise tell us what you bought
[bin555] Food processor for kitchen, quilt for home, pillow for home.
[J0hn] I bought food processor sold by amazon and got tracked 5%
[hackups] Same. I bought a Thermos water bottle which I have checked it's kitchen but TCB didn't think so.
[trails] I'm with you on this. I used this current TCB offer to buy a rice cooker. Amazon tells me it is ranked over 10,000 in Home. Cashback tracks and gives 0.04%, not 5%.
[DrFish] I'd say you have a valid claim for missing cashback then? That's clearly a home item. Screenshot that + the topcashback page to keep as a reference if needed for the claim in the future.
[trails] Submitted a missing cashback claim and see what TCB say.
[CheapCookie] Same story with me, brought a moka pot, it did not track at 5%
Going to have to contact support about it.
[toniyellow] Similar experience, bought from Home Improvement yesterday https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/984336 and it tracked at 0.8%
[PainToad] ACCC needs to crack down on cash back companies.
[Zippy7] I am in the same situation are you as I made a purchase yesterday with the 10% showing for Home Improvement but it tracked at a tiny amount.
I am going to give them a bit of time as I know @tightarse is on family leave at the moment.
Basically need to remember to follow up in a week or two.
[GGinger1] Is this 20% cashback for amazon devices a rare offer? (I'm new to this whole cashback thing)
